codex.robotica.guide.title: Your next steps
codex.robotica.guide.all_done: Every step is done. Robotica is yours.
codex.robotica.guide.missing: The guide steps are missing from this resource pack.
codex.robotica.guide.click: Click an icon for its recipe
advancements.robotica.guide.root.title: Robotica
advancements.robotica.guide.root.descrip: Robots do the boring work. Start with copper, wood and cobblestone. The Codex shows every recipe.
Craft a Copper Gear: four copper ingots around a cobblestone.
Craft Stumpy or Sprout. Then wind a Mainspring to power it.
advancements.robotica.guide.mainspring.d: Put a Mainspring in a Winding Crank, then hold right-click on the crank.
Place Stumpy by trees or Sprout by crops, with a chest or Supply Crate touching it.
advancements.robotica.guide.robot_workin: Right-click your robot with the wound Mainspring.
advancements.robotica.guide.hammer.title: Hammer Time
advancements.robotica.guide.hammer.descr: Make a Tinker's Hammer: it mines 3x3, and 2 ingots in the grid make a plate.
advancements.robotica.guide.first_iron.d: Smelt iron: a generator, a battery and power tools are a few ingots away.
advancements.robotica.guide.mining_drone: Craft a Mining Drone. Give it a battery and torches: it digs a 3x3 tunnel and brings the loot back.
advancements.robotica.guide.generator.de: Place a Combustion Generator and right-click it with coal or logs.
advancements.robotica.guide.charger.desc: Place a Charger next to the generator. Right-click it with a cell or drill.
Craft a Copper Cell. In your inventory it recharges the tool in your hand.
advancements.robotica.guide.tesla.title: Plugged In
advancements.robotica.guide.tesla.descri: Put a Tesla Coil on your generator. Tesla Linker: sneak-right-click the coil, then right-click a machine.
advancements.robotica.guide.power_tool.d: Smithing table: Tool Upgrade Kit I + hammer + Electric Motor = Bore Drill. The Felling Axe becomes a Chainsaw.
advancements.robotica.guide.basic_circui: Craft a Basic Circuit (needs gold). It opens solar, cards, farm kits, warp pads and more.
advancements.robotica.guide.exo.title: Suit Up
advancements.robotica.guide.exo.descript: Craft an Exo-Frame piece. J opens its module screen.
advancements.robotica.guide.drones.title: Air Support
advancements.robotica.guide.drones.descr: Craft a Sentry Drone to guard, or a Courier Drone to move items.
advancements.robotica.guide.grinder.desc: Place a Grinder: ores come out as two dusts by default. Flint in the media slot adds a bit more.
Place a Metal Press: 1 ingot = 1 plate.
advancements.robotica.guide.storage.desc: Place a Storage Terminal: 81 slots, search and a crafting grid. Needs a little power.
advancements.robotica.guide.capacitor_ba: Build a Capacitor Bank: a hollow Bank Casing box, Controller and Port in the walls, Capacitors and a Transfer Coil inside.
advancements.robotica.guide.upgrade_card: Craft an upgrade card and right-click a robot or machine with it.
advancements.robotica.guide.farm_kit.des: Right-click a placed Stumpy or Sprout with a Farm Kit Mk2.
advancements.robotica.guide.warp.title: Home Run
advancements.robotica.guide.warp.descrip: Place two Warp Pads, power them, stand on one and right-click it.
advancements.robotica.guide.thorium.desc: Mine Thorium Ore (Y -48 to 32). With iron, an Alloy Smelter makes Ferrothorium.
advancements.robotica.guide.ferrothorium: Make Ferrothorium in an Alloy Smelter. Its plates build Age 2 machines.
advancements.robotica.guide.diamonds.des: Find diamonds: they make the Excavator and the Age 2 parts.
advancements.robotica.guide.excavator.de: Place an Excavator with a chest next to it. It digs to bedrock; speed cards and power make it fast.
advancements.robotica.guide.survey_rig.d: Place a Survey Rig: it turns power into random ores. Slow, and very hungry.
advancements.robotica.guide.age2.title: Servo Age
advancements.robotica.guide.age2.descrip: Craft an Advanced Circuit or a Reinforced Casing.
advancements.robotica.guide.assembler.de: Place an Assembler: Thermocouples, fuel pellets and cheaper ladder parts.
advancements.robotica.guide.rtg.title: Slow Burn
advancements.robotica.guide.rtg.descript: Place a Radioisotope Generator with Thorium Fuel Pellets: steady power, a long burn per pellet.
advancements.robotica.guide.fission.desc: Build a Fission Reactor: Reactor Casing box, Fuel Rods in full columns, coolant beside them, a Power Port.
advancements.robotica.guide.foundry.desc: Find a Rusted Foundry (copper ruins in plains, deserts, badlands) or craft a Signal Flare.
advancements.robotica.guide.colossus.des: Use a Signal Flare on a Colossus Altar and beat the Scrap Colossus. Hit its open core when it overheats.
advancements.robotica.guide.servo_core.d: Get a Servo Core: it makes the Servo Drill and the Mob Replicator.
Smith your Bore Drill into a Servo Drill: 5x5 and vein mining.
advancements.robotica.guide.vial.title: Sample Size
advancements.robotica.guide.vial.descrip: Right-click one kind of monster eight times with an Essence Vial.
advancements.robotica.guide.replicator.d: Build the 3x3x3 Mob Replicator: empty centre, at least one Replicator Glass.
advancements.robotica.guide.age3.title: Deep Age
advancements.robotica.guide.age3.descrip: Craft a Quantum Circuit: blaze rods and netherite from the Nether.
advancements.robotica.guide.pyrolite.des: Mine Pyrolite Ore in the Nether, most in basalt deltas. It alloys into Pyrosteel.
advancements.robotica.guide.magma_core.d: Get a Magma Core: Magma Drill, Arc Blade, Rift Upgrade, Age 3 mobs in the replicator.
Smith a Magma Drill. Turn on auto-smelt in its settings.
advancements.robotica.guide.exo_mk3.desc: Smith an Exo piece to Mk3 (Blazing Casing, Superconductor Coil). One more slot; Flight and Kinetic Shield need it.
advancements.robotica.guide.age4.title: Antigrav Age
advancements.robotica.guide.age4.descrip: Craft a Null Circuit: ender pearls and a nether star.
advancements.robotica.guide.resonite.des: Mine Resonite Ore on the outer End islands. It alloys into Resonant Alloy.
advancements.robotica.guide.antigrav_cor: Get an Antigrav Core: Null Drill, Null Lance, Portal Projectors.
advancements.robotica.guide.null_drill.d: Smith a Null Drill and dig a 12x12x12 cube in one swing.
advancements.robotica.guide.fusion.title: Star in a Jar
advancements.robotica.guide.fusion.descr: Build the 7x3x7 Fusion Reactor, charge it with FE and add fusion fuel.
advancements.robotica.guide.flight.title: Lift Off
advancements.robotica.guide.flight.descr: Put a Flight Module in an Exo chestplate and press K to fly.
advancements.robotica.guide.exo_mk4.desc: Smith an Exo piece to Mk4 (Null Casing, Resonant Lattice). One more slot, fireproof.
advancements.robotica.guide.portal.title: Through the Lens
advancements.robotica.guide.portal.descr: Link two Portal Projectors with a Linking Card and step through the portal.
